promised.summary: Management has met all key post-merger milestones: normalizing credit-to-deposit ratio below 100%, preserving NIM in the 3.4-3.5% corridor, and maintaining pristine asset quality.

promises.target: Reduce LDR to below 100% by H2 FY27
promises.quote: Our credit-to-deposit ratio will systematically glide down below 100 percent as deposit mobilisation outpaces credit growth.
promises.actual: LDR successfully reduced to 99.4% as of September 30, 2026.

promises.quote: We expect our core net interest margin to hold stable in the 3.4 to 3.5 percent range through the merger digestion cycle.
promises.actual: Reported NIM of 3.46% in Q1 FY27 and 3.48% in Q2 FY27.

promises.quote: Branch expansion will continue at a measured cadence of 600 to 700 branches annually to deepen our liability franchise.
promises.actual: Added 318 branches in H1 FY27, tracking exactly on plan.

promises.quote: Underwriting discipline across retail and wholesale books gives us confidence that GNPA will comfortably remain beneath 1.40 percent.
promises.actual: Gross NPA stood at 1.36% in Q1 FY27 and 1.34% in Q2 FY27.

snapshot.description: HDFC Bank is India's largest private sector bank following its mega-merger with HDFC Ltd, serving over 90 million customers via 9,000+ branches and command of 20%+ national retail credit.

cash.note: Banking liabilities: CASA ratio of 37.8% backed by extensive granular deposit base.

targets.guidance: Outpace credit growth by 300-400 bps to build liquidity cushion
Double home loan penetration among existing salary account holders

bull_points: Huge cross-sell potential of home loans to 90M+ pre-existing bank deposit customers.
Market leader in low-cost CASA deposits with unmatched trust and distribution reach.
Industry-best NPA provision coverage ratio (>74%) insulating balance sheet against credit cycles.
bear_points: High systemic interest rate environment makes retail deposit gathering costly and competitive.
Regulatory scrutiny on high credit-to-deposit ratio during post-merger integration.
